blocks.text: Kris Aquino expressed her immense pride for her youngest son, Bimby Aquino, who “spoke from the heart” about health in his first major solo endorsement. Bimby, who was recently introduced as the new ambassador of a health maintenance organization, was featured in an advertisement clip shared on Tuesday, Sept. 22. In the video, the young actor-TV host spoke about his mother’s autoimmune diseases, saying they are still lucky they can afford the healthcare that has kept her alive. “But health should not be a privilege, nor should it be a struggle.
